stories.title: Stakes and Art
stories.content:
The night rain drummed the window and stirred up an odor of pungent liquor. Carlotta didn't like the smell, but she took comfort in that only those compelled by the strongest of desires would venture out in such weather, and such individuals were rarely subtle.

A woman in worn yet carefully maintained clothing tried to appear nonchalant, but her eyes were fixated on the auctioneer's every move like a desperate gambler. A flamboyant man in the central foyer loudly expounded upon various art styles, unwilling to relinquish the attention he had attracted, all the while unaware that he had conflated several distinct schools of art. Finally, a boy lurked by a window, furtively glancing at Carlotta before catching himself and looking away—rather tactless, but by no means a problem.

For Carlotta, this was a game whose outcome was hers to decide.

This was not Carlotta's first auction. On stage under a soft spotlight, the pieces came and went. Potential buyers murmured among themselves, forgoing discussions of artistic merit in favor of analyzing each work's price history. Creating art is a noble endeavor, but the business of art is far less so. Here each transaction was a present wager on a future payoff.

Even so, Carlotta still raised her placard for niche works that held little mainstream appeal. To her, these pieces were part of a grand strategy—whether a meaningless melange of shapes or a deconstructive expression of true artistry... time would reveal the answer, with returns far exceeding expectations.

Such behavior was initially met with skepticism, but Carlotta's air of certainty soon began to sway the bidders and shape their choices. It seemed as though she had a strategy uniquely grounded in art theory, aesthetic sensibility, and market insight. Yet she was about to go one step further in search of greater heights.

And then, the moment arrived, right then and there...
 
In the final seconds of bidding, Carlotta raised her placard once more to the astonishment of onlookers. Seeing this, the flamboyant man instantly one-upped her bid.

Countdown. Bid. Countdown. Bid... The auction rushed forward, each bid thicker and faster than the last, pushing everyone's emotions toward a suffocating crescendo. The woman in worn clothing widened her eyes in disbelief at the rising sums. The boy scarcely caught his breath as he whipped his head back and forth at the frenzy of activity.

Just as the auctioneer's hammer was about to fall, Carlotta waved at her rival with a rueful smile. "How unexpected that there is another who recognizes the true worth of this painting. Your willingness to stake such a sum... It rightfully belongs to you."

The event drew to a close, but Carlotta still had a few matters to settle.

She watched the man leave with the painting before retreating into a quiet corner. The boy who had locked eyes with her earlier approached.

"I let slip that Carlotta <te href=850101>Montelli</te> had her eyes set on a masterpiece. Just like you instructed, Miss."

Carlotta smiled and gave the boy his reward. If he stayed agreeable, she wouldn't mind taking him into her confidence again, should she need him again for some future trivial task. As for the woman lingering nearby...

"Miss Carlotta, I'm very grateful for all that you've done for me and my father. It's just... it's just..." The woman hesitated, searching for the right words. Carlotta didn't miss a beat.

"No, the piece sold at a fair price. I used my methods, but your father's painting is indeed worth that much. Sometimes, people simply lack patience." 

Everyone got what they wanted. So did she.

With that thought, Carlotta left the auction hall to disappear into the darkness and rain.

stories.title: Past Overdue
stories.content:
That night the rain came suddenly.

It flooded the streets and filled those final moments before midnight with a deeper misery. Carlotta lifted her eyes to glimpse blurred shadows through the faint light piercing sheets of water. Wasn't she another shadow in the downpour? Yes... A shadow that reaped lives to right past wrongs.

The rain would not stop her from finding the one she sought.

Click... Click... Click. The sound of heels on pavement drew nearer. A door creaked open, and Carlotta strode inside. She had traveled across <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> to find the man standing before her, nearly forgotten by time. Her words were terse, "To be frank, I've come in the name of the <te href=850101>Montellis</te> to read you your obituary."

"I knew you would come."

Silver threaded through his hair, his face worn by time and regret. His voice was steady as he regarded Carlotta blankly.

"The Montellis do not forget blood debts. Sooner or later, I knew I'd be found."
 
A window in the room was ajar, and a cold breeze crept in, bringing the chill of the night. The old man shivered, but his frailty only irritated Carlotta. He spoke as though he hadn't once schemed against the Montellis and ingratiated himself with the <te href=850094>Fisalias</te>. As if he hadn't orchestrated the Montelli headquarters raid which cost so many their lives, even after the family had agreed to a deal over the West End.

Carlotta's retort was sharp.

"You knew the consequences of your actions."

"Bah! You Montellis never change. It's been ten years. Everything's over. You took back the West End, while I've been cowering like a rat in a hole. I live in fear that come any rain-sodden night, someone like you might sneak in and end my life."

The old man sighed, his expression hardening. His hand shot out for a hidden weapon. 

Carlotta said nothing. Her crystal morphed into a gun in a silent but lethal threat.

For Carlotta, this was not about revenge, this was about unpaid debts and lost respect. Any Montelli could die, but as long as one Montelli remained, the family would not fall. A Montelli's absolute trust in their kin gave them the peace of mind to lay down their lives for the good of the family. Should they fall, another would take up their mantle and finish what had to be done. So, even after ten years, this debt had to be settled. Only then would it truly be over. It was never a question of money and closure but of loyalty and commitment.

Bang! Another "gem" shattered into shards. 

The old man slumped to the floor. He looked up, determined to keep Carlotta in sight, but he could no longer move.
 
"Cough... cough... You have not won... this game does not end.... in death..."
 
Yes. It was a game that only ended once spent. 

Carlotta repeated the thought as she stepped into the street. The night air gently brushed her cheek, carrying away the room's echoing silence.

She closed the door. Before that, A note with "Debts Cleared" printed on it fell gently by the foot of the old man.

And so... where there is death inside, outside there will always be Ragunna.

stories.title: Ballroom Death of Dance
stories.content:
That night, the rain kept sliding down Carlotta's hair onto her face. She felt drained staggering forward, as if she were drowning in the fine drizzle. 

Carlotta rued her habit of not carrying an umbrella. She desperately wanted to rest under one, but the approaching footsteps told her there would be no respite. No matter, Carlotta bit down on her glove and tore it off her hand. She had to continue this deadly dance with her life on the line. 

Earlier that night... the most opulent ballroom at City Hall played host to a gathering attended by the Order, the <te href=850094>Fisalias</te>, and the <te href=850101>Montellis</te>, all powerful forces with their own agendas. Carlotta was no different. She had chosen a dress and heels that offered her freedom of movement. She would melt into the crowd and wait in the shadows.
 
Carlotta stepped onto the dance floor, exchanging a polite smile with the Fisalia representative.

"You look especially enchanting tonight, Miss Carlotta. Do you have plans for later?"

"No, just enjoying the evening," Carlotta replied, her fingers resting lightly on the waist of the stunning woman, whose hand slid up Carlotta's forearm in response. Their palms met and their bodies swayed in unison, their ruffled skirts like petals of a blooming flower.

"Come now, surely you did not come just to dance? There are other Montellis here, I presume?"

"You know how I enjoy these affairs. From the way you watch, I'd say the Fisalias have great stakes in tonight's proceedings."

The beautiful woman shifted her rhythm, grip tightening as she attempted to seize the lead. Carlotta let the pull guide her, spinning easily back into the embrace.

"The Order holds the reins of this city. We Fisalias will not allow you to disrupt the delicate balance. The Montelli vision is too radical."
 
"You call us radical, and yet it is you who hungers for power. You seek to control the tide, as if it could ever be held still."  
 
Their duet grew increasingly frenetic as both sought to seize the upper hand. It became a dance of delicate evasion, brief moments of contact before pulling apart in the same fluid motion. As the music reached its climax, the woman drew back, glancing at the crowd, her gaze searching for the other hidden Montellis.

Carlotta gripped the woman's hand, guiding her back into their rhythmic dance. The music kept them bound together. The woman had no escape, and she dared not make a scene. All she could do was glare at Carlotta with malice.

"The Montellis have ears everywhere. From the start, you were after my "children." I hope you're prepared to dance until death do us part."
 
Their dance suddenly took on a new meaning. Carlotta halted, spun, struck, and the targets fell... Her tango became a single, deadly waltz with the woman's guards and "children" all the way to here, their struggle punctuated by the relentless rain.

Carlotta felt poison seep into her wound, its mind-bending venom ravaging her veins. Something metallic trickled from the corner of her mouth. Carlotta smirked, letting out a soft, bitter laugh.  

Was this the fate of that woman's last dance partner? No matter. Sooner or later, all who deal in death meet its embrace.

As the poison stripped Carlotta of her senses and tore away all reason and sanity, she bowed, and then with a smile, shone with a brilliance that turned night into day. If death was inevitable, why hold back on the dance of a lifetime...?

stories.title: In the Name of the Montellis
stories.content:
That night, Carlotta knew it was raining. She couldn't see the droplets, but the rainwater had left streaks on the windowpane.

Carlotta shifted her skirts and looked into the mirror. The wound had healed nicely and the scar was no longer visible. The toxins had also been completely purged. But she wasn't keen on resting. She kept it to herself, but doing nothing made her uneasy as if something was slipping through her fingers. Carlotta decided to consult Grandfather on how best to handle the recent "troubles."
 
She found him in a corridor by the foyer. A late sleeper like herself, it was not unusual for Grandfather to be up at this hour. She could not tell whether he was watching the rain outside or admiring the painting on the wall, or perhaps...

"Grandfather, are you waiting for me?"

"Not exactly. You see, I was thinking about you when you first joined the family."
 
His response caught Carlotta off guard. Truth be told, she didn't like the person she was back then: naïve, weak, abandoned, far removed from being a <te href=850101>Montelli</te>. There was so much she had to learn—about <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>, the Montellis, and problems that required elegant solutions. Almost no one believed in her except Grandfather. Back then the only thing she took pride in was her Forte, which she instinctively wielded as a means to an end. Over time, she had adapted to the Montelli Code, using her abilities to handle the family's more delicate matters.

Had something gone wrong in the process?

Carlotta believed that her current role in the Montelli hierarchy was most beneficial to the family. They had accepted her, approved of her, and now, they needed her. She was a true granddaughter to the Padrino, more deserving of the Montelli name than ever before. So why was Grandfather bringing up the past?
 
"Do you remember? When you asked me to make you my Executor, I gave you those opal gloves right here, in this very spot," Grandfather gently patted Carlotta's shoulder. "I have never doubted your abilities, but I've begun to wonder if that was truly what you wanted."
 
What she truly wanted and what she was doing now... Carlotta saw little difference between the two. Life stretched on and through it, people needed certain beliefs, ideals, or loved ones to be their anchor. For Carlotta being a Montelli was her anchor—and the Montelli family was her everything.
 
"No, that's where you're mistaken," Grandfather said softly as if seeing exactly what Carlotta was thinking, "A true Montelli does not live solely for the family. She does not exist to only follow rules, whether set by myself or by the family. She must feel the world and make her own rules."

"I want to see you shine because I believe you possess brilliance from within. Before you constrained yourself to the idea of what it meant to be a Montelli, you had just begun to define your own rules."

The sky outside began to lighten... In the end, Grandfather declined to let Carlotta keep the role of Executor. Instead, he asked her to write a letter inviting representatives from <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te> to Ragunna. Carlotta looked out the window. After the rain, Ragunna was enveloped in a dull gray mist. The city was a slumbering beast, waiting for the grand arrival of the Carnevale to awaken it.

At that moment, Carlotta was unaware that it was during this rainy night that Francesco Montelli made a decision that would shape the future of the Montellis. He would employ special means to return the power of choice to her hands. And she, like her original self, would pave the way for what was to come.

stories.title: In the Name of Carlotta
stories.content:
At dusk, the rain has finally stopped.

The soft glow of the setting sun gently washes over Carlotta as she sips coffee by the harbor. The tide rolls in and out, its golden ripples mirroring the endless cycle of Ragunna's days and nights. With no particular destination in mind, she wandered, pausing at random. This isn't her norm, but in the future, she might just make a habit of it, much like she has started making a habit of searching for parts of herself that belonged to Carlotta alone, separate from the <te href=850101>Montellis</te>.

After celebrating the <te href=850102>Carnevale</te> with the distinguished guest, and exposing Capollo's betrayal with {Male=his;Female=her} help, Carlotta finally understood what Grandfather had been unable to fully express on that rainy night.

He was concerned that she might do things for the family that went against her principles. Grandfather hadn't drawn a path for her based on his own past. He had only hoped that she would avoid being trapped by the established pattern.

But the truth is more complex than that.

Her decision to remain as Executor was certainly made with the family's interest at heart. But every step that led to her decision was a choice she gladly made, and in the end, that was all there was to it. She was never one to be bound by rules. Not in the past. Not now. And not ever.

Naturally, as a Montelli, she could not afford to think only of herself. She was drawn to extremes, to reckless solutions, unafraid of change or risk. But when it came time to act, when decisions had to be made, she tempered those inclinations. In a way, this was indeed a constraint imposed by her identity—a collar forged by blood and duty. But it was also a bond that anchored her. 

She is Carlotta Montelli. She will always be needed. She will be cast aside again. Despite that single constraint, she has a freedom few could claim.

A life devoted to creating a singular, defining masterpiece—Carlotta has seen many such lives.

The tapestry of her future is a subject far more enticing, and one she is more than willing to weave, thread by thread. To capture the essence of who she is, she will continue to cut, arrange, and layer... until she can call it a rich enough work of art.

But for now, she wants to permit herself a small sense of pride.

Carlotta isn't ready to bear the parts of herself that exist only in the quiet spaces of her mind... But perhaps {PlayerName} would be the exception. Indeed, she still preferred to call {Male=him;Female=her} Cat's Eye. They had walked shoulder to shoulder for a time, but in the end, neither of them could have paused their journey for the other. {Male=He;Female=She} had been blunt about her "excessive perfection," and so, in keeping with the promise she made to "be less reserved," Carlotta will weave that Cat's Eye into the fabric of her story. She can't shake the feeling that fate is not done with them yet. As for when, or how, or what new adventures may unfold between them... she can scarcely wait.

In the distance, a Gondola cuts through still water as it glides back toward the dock. A chorus of calls between those aboard and onshore marks the fading echoes of the day's clamor. After the rain, no one can say what transpired in the dark of the night. For now, only the dying light brushes her skin, marking the end of the cycle of the day. 

She takes one last sip from her cup, turns, and walks into the encroaching darkness.

In the stillness of the world, she will dance her own dance.

voices.title: Thoughts: I
voices.content: Before our paths crossed, I'd only heard stories about you from Grandfather. But <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> is rather secluded, and not all the tales that reach us remain true. I found myself wondering who you really were, and you surpassed every expectation. Your arrival didn't just disrupt the delicate balance in Ragunna, it also shed light on doubts and hesitations that had kept me trapped for so long.

voices.title: Thoughts: II
voices.content: Be light and swift, steady and precise. One hand on the waist, the other on the shoulder. Let the momentum carry you into a perfect arc as you spin… Hehe, you see? Combat and ballroom dancing do share a few similarities, wouldn't you agree?

voices.title: Thoughts: III
voices.content: In our family, we encounter all sorts of people, but they generally fall into three categories: the wealthy, the poor, and young newcomers with nothing to lose. Regardless, those that intrigue me the most are the ones with a fire in their eyes. You see, those who don't know what they truly want are often adrift, chasing after everything but never holding onto a thing.

voices.title: Thoughts: IV
voices.content: I've come to find a genuine pleasure working with you—truly, I do not say this out of formality. Whether it's business or not, I truly cherish every moment we share.

voices.title: Thoughts: V
voices.content: You have the most beautiful eyes. When you're focused intently, they shine like gems... I must admit, I find myself captivated. So, why not keep me in your sights a little longer? Perhaps then, I could be the one to make that sparkle even brighter.

voices.title: Carlotta's Hobby
voices.content: The beauty of art shouldn't be confined by a viewer's knowledge or taste. Whether it's the latest trends, timeless classics, or avant-garde surrealism, each offers a unique vantage point. What I truly admire is the emotion and passion artists pour into their work. That's why I connect them with patrons who can truly appreciate their vision, ensuring their brilliance is recognized and valued.

voices.title: Carlotta's Trouble
voices.content: Long ago, I witnessed a storm that I will never forget. The air was suffocating, damp, and tinged with a faint, rusty odor. I stood there in silence, feeling utterly helpless. Since that day, I've faced many more storms. Instead of retreating, I choose to walk into the rain, seeking justice before it can wash away all the blood and pain. Now that I think about it, perhaps it wasn't the rain itself I loathed, but what it brought with it. After all, it's difficult to hold onto one's dignity in a downpour, and in those moments, we all reveal parts of ourselves we'd rather keep hidden.

voices.title: Favorite Food
voices.content: When it comes to flavors, I don't have any particular preferences. But isn't it curious how food can take on a meaning of its own depending on the company? Take my family, for instance—we say true unity only comes after sharing a bottle of honeyed wine and a slice of orange pie. What do you think? Shall we try that next time?

voices.title: Disliked Food
voices.content: Have you ever attended one of those lavish traditional banquets? The portions are modest, but the pomp is overwhelming. Silver bowls, crystal goblets, and gem-studded plates parade before you, each one more ostentatious than the last, all to flaunt the host's wealth... Before you can even begin to eat, you must endure dozens of needless formalities. To me, they seem to forget that true decorum and elegance are not about such excess.

voices.title: Ideals
voices.content: The <te href=850101>Montellis'</te> legacy is built and sustained by every member of the our family. We know the world is far greater than <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> or <te href=850096>Rinascita</te> alone. Just as our ancestors once ventured into the unknown, we too must continue to chart new courses. Now, a golden opportunity lies before us... I need only to seize it and take that step forward. Perhaps more than just one.

voices.title: Chat: I
voices.content: Everyone who handles family directives has a codename, each with a matching token. Mine is the opal. While they do shine and dazzle, my opals aren't real jewels. They're merely crystals reshaped by my Forte. Whether as decorations or ammunition, I use them to create the brilliance I desire.

voices.title: Chat: II
voices.content: My past is no secret within my family or among old acquaintances… I've been called many things: the abandoned orphan, descendant of the lesser branch, prominent young lady, and efficient executor. Each title represents a part of me, though none capture the whole. To dance on the edge of danger, one must learn to wear many masks. For the future of the <te href=850101>Montelli</te> family, I will play any role that's required of me.

voices.title: About Brant
voices.content: He's the captain leading his crew through tempestuous seas, and I often wonder whether his gaze from the deck reveals ambition, or selflessness and passion. Our family once extended an invitation to him, but he declined, remarking, "A captain's ship is his alone, and he will never abandon it." Thus, we remain partners with aligned interests, and that suits us just fine.

voices.title: About Roccia
voices.content: I've always been curious about something. Just how much can her box, <te href=850122>Pero</te>, actually hold? New designs, costumes, the fine wines the troupe keeps hidden, shimmering sea gems and shells... And Roccia's thoughts and feelings, too. Though Roccia herself rarely speaks her mind, Pero seems to reveal them all.

voices.title: About Phoebe
voices.content: Phoebe is as pure and innocent as a budding lily. Her kindness and devotion are beyond question. Yet, without sufficient strength, such virtues might lead one into the trap of blind faith. I mean no disrespect, but this is a dilemma every believer faces at some point—whether they are following a mere illusion shaped by others' agendas or upholding principles and beliefs that truly have meaning.

voices.title: About Zani
voices.content: Zani is wary of unnecessary, inefficient tasks because she excels at completing her work with haste, precision, and quality. Although it may seem that these aspects contradict each other, they actually complement one another. The family imposes few restrictions on private commissions, so if you have a challenging request, feel free to approach her. Oh, but do ensure the compensation is appropriate.

voices.title: About Francesco
voices.content: Some people see family as a matter of blood and heritage, while others, unbound by such conventions, consider those who share their ideals as family. I am deeply grateful for the protection, opportunities, and insight Grandfather has given me, along with the pride of being a <te href=850101>Montelli</te>. He embodies the spirit of the Montelli family, and I am determined to honor his legacy. Like him, I will lead our family forward with action, as a true Montelli would.

voices.title: Birthday Wishes
voices.content: Happy birthday, {PlayerName}. I must confess, ever since I found out about your birthday, I've been thinking about the perfect gift for you. You likely already possess many treasures, so I wanted mine to be something unique, practical, and delightful—something that would bring you joy and remind you of me. So, here it is: a pistol reshaped by my Forte. It symbolizes that you have the freedom to do as you wish. Whether or not you're a Montelli, this promise holds true, always, in the name of Carlotta <te href=850101>Montelli</te>.

voices.title: Idle: I
voices.content: Bang. The white has been dyed red.

voices.title: Idle: III
voices.content: To shine or to die? Merely two sides of the same coin.

voices.title: Self-Introduction
voices.content: I am Carlotta Montelli, the second lady of the <te href=850101>Montelli</te> family. In certain situations, I might also be known as Opal. I have a talent for uncovering value and solving problems. Whether it's for business or building friendships, you can rely on me. If you're interested in closer collaboration... well, that's certainly possible. However, are you prepared to offer your faith, life, and future in exchange?

voices.title: Greeting
voices.content: Fate has led you to me, and considering the terms I'm offering… You wouldn't refuse me, would you?

voices.title: Join Team: I
voices.content: Let's prove our value to each other.

voices.title: Join Team: II
voices.content: See? I always choose the winning side—yours.

voices.title: Join Team: III
voices.content: New investments, new deals… I promise you won't be disappointed.

voices.title: Ascension: I
voices.content: Now, my Forte can reshape even more. Your labour has truly borne fruit.

voices.title: Ascension: II
voices.content: Such delightful and irresistible power. Well, now we have another shared secret.

voices.title: Ascension: III
voices.content: Your generosity is as unwavering as ever. But how should I repay you? After all, the most precious things are often those that defy definition.

voices.title: Ascension: IV
voices.content: The opal shines even more brightly… It seems you find greater pleasure in the crafting process itself than in the finished gems.

voices.title: Ascension: V
voices.content: Indeed, very well. Please, continue… Heh, did you not expect me to say that? I relish all the experiences you offered and make no secret of the ambition stirred. So, see this through—what I wish for and what I can offer go far beyond what is presented now.

voices.title: Resonance Liberation: V
voices.content: In the name of the <te href=850101>Montellis</te>.

goods.title: Art's Return
goods.content: This is no mere collage made of disparate materials but rather an interpretation of inspiration and a concept of constructivist ideals. Its creator started her career marked by striking innovation, yet she remained deeply underappreciated. Carlotta, however, recognized this "hidden gem," describing her work as "an impression of otherness with a hauntingly poetic touch." Now a celebrated installation artist in Ragunna, she crafted this fine piece as a unique token of gratitude for Carlotta's sponsorship and unwavering trust.

goods.title: Executor's Case
goods.content:
A delicate case decorated with intricately carved gemstones, ideal for any formal occasion. They say a lady's bag is where her secrets hide, which is certainly true for Carlotta. The perfume bottle, for instance, is a grenade in disguise, while the glasses are special instruments displaying real-time locations and query results. Beyond their ornamental charm, these items are Carlotta's most reliable allies in her missions.
In beauty, they adorn; in death, they unmake—perfectly suit their owner's needs.

goods.title: Family's Creed
goods.content:
A pair of black gloves, their lustrous sheen reminiscent of the night, adorned with gemstones bearing the same name as the wearer—Opal.
Within the family, there are many unspoken rules, subtle and unnecessary to voice aloud. One such rule is this: those who wear black gloves must quietly resolve any "troubles" to serve the family's needs.
Yet, this is not a matter of compromise, but rather Carlotta's own choice. The family has shown her the wider world, and now she will guide them into an even greater one—both in the name of the true <te href=850101>Montelli</te> and her own.

charaInfo.info: Hailing from Ashinohara, the Miko of Flaming Sakura now remains in Lahai-Roi as the last and only member of the Special Response Force.
charaInfo.talent_doc: [Spacetrek Collective: Classified Archive] Interview Dossier: Hiyuki Due to multifaceted considerations, we have foregone a truly comprehensive evaluation of the representative from Ashinohara—the Miko of Flaming Sakura. The majority of the intelligence gathered herein is based on her personal testimony. In the recorder's professional estimation, corroborated through subsequent cross-referencing, she appears to harbor no intention of concealing any information regarding her background. "After all, information regarding the 'Miko of Eternal Flaming Sakura' can be found in just about any Ashinohara elementary school textbook..." According to Hiyuki's own account, the source of her Forte is the "Suzu," a Legacy Talisman worn on her right wrist. Hiyuki describes the Suzu as follows: It grants the bearer the ability to perceive and utilize "future possibilities" of oneself, though it does not allow for direct communication with these "shadows of future possibility." The freezing power she often wields in combat also stems from the "Suzu." "Verified via official Ashinohara reports: The Legacy Talismans are five relics left behind by the Sentinels, distributed among the internal factions of Ashinohara for safekeeping." "Among them, the Suzu is described as granting its bearer the power to 'draw upon the future.'" Consequently, it is determined that the fundamental source of her exceptional combat prowess remains her own inherent skill. However, the "futures" available for her to draw upon are not infinite. Out of concern for her physiological lifespan, aggressive deployment of her abilities is strongly advised against. "Investigation confirms that every Miko of Flaming Sakura has shared a singular cause of death: vanishing from the battlefield without a trace following excessive use of the Suzu."
charaInfo.talent_certification: The subject's Rabelle's Waveform diagram exhibits an elliptical oscillation pattern with a stable Time Domain representation. No abnormal fluctuations were observed. Examination results are determined to be within normal parameters. Current Overclocking threshold is exceptionally high, and subject stability remains robust. There is no risk of Overclocking, and the subject has no prior history of Overclocking. However, a course of psychological intervention is recommended. "This miko... How should I put this..." "Ashinohara textbooks never show her face, but they're clear about one thing. She is the strongest living warrior in all of Ashinohara." "And yet, with all that combat, her readings stay perfectly stable. Something about that just doesn't sit right..." "I get your concern, but the data is clear. There's not a single irregularity." "...Then what about those shadows? Like parallel-universe versions of herself from some movie?" "Hardly. It must be the Suzu's power. Just as the Ashinohara records describe, it allows her to 'draw upon the future' to a certain extent."

stories.title: Words Left Unsaid
stories.content:
The first time Hiyuki heard the truth of her own past, it spilled from Gyokuro's drunken lips. Hiyuki's mouth tightened. Without a word, she poured herself a glass of the bitter liquor.
 
"Hiyuki... My dear Hiyuki..." 
"You can't do this. You can't be the damn Miko of Flaming Sakura... Your life was never meant to be like this!"
 
Hiyuki's eyes narrowed. If the people of <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te> saw their usually dignified and poised Miko of Flaming Sakura acting like this behind closed doors... 
 
The second hand ticked. The minute hand followed. At last, the hour hand lurched forward. By Ashinohara time, this very moment marked Hiyuki's transition into adulthood. She sighed and downed the drink in one burning gulp.
 
"You managed. You think I cannot?"
 
The liquor scorched her throat and settled like lead in her slight frame. So this was what they called the "drink of adulthood." Its taste, she decided, was hardly worth the wait. Hiyuki stood and draped a blanket over Gyokuro's muttering form. She lingered in the corner for a long moment. At last, she stepped forward, tucked the edges tight, and closed the door softly behind her.
 
The next morning, Gyokuro's fury toward the steward tasked with the Legacy Talisman's succession rang out loud enough to be heard two streets away.
 
The Suzu's power lay in "drawing upon the future." In simple terms, it meant every use exacted a toll from the bearer's remaining lifespan. In the worst case, it meant a successor who inherited the bell today might vanish into nothingness in their very first battle against a Threnodian. Because the price was so high, successors were usually chosen early. Hiyuki had stayed at Gyokuro's side for more than a decade. Even if Gyokuro refused to name her... who else could possibly be chosen?
 
The steward, unable to handle Gyokuro's temper, could only offer a strained, placating smile. "Even if not Hiyuki, surely you must name someone, Lady Miko."
 
Gyokuro fell silent for a few breaths. She sighed, cleared her throat, and prepared to resume her tirade.
 
It was Hiyuki who finally opened the door, ending the farce.
 
"For years, I have journeyed with you through Ashinohara. I know what each duty demands." 
"I have mastered every art a miko must know. The weaving of charms, the ceremonial dances—all from teachers of your own choosing."
"Only I can ensure the name of the Flaming Sakura remains untarnished, Gyokuro... No. Lady Miko."
 
Gyokuro's brow furrowed. She waved a hand dismissively. 

"You've learned it all, have you? Then don't you realize the Suzu will be the death of you?"
"I was an orphan you took in. My family lies buried beneath the snow from that Threnodian attack. I have no attachments left."
 
The room fell suffocatingly quiet. The only sound was the raspy, obsessive scrape of Gyokuro's thumb as she rubbed the bell on her wrist. She tried to speak, but in the end, no words came.

stories.title: There Will Never Be Another...
stories.content:
The days following Hiyuki's succession were inevitably frantic. Where once she had simply walked in Gyokuro's shadow, she now found the weight of every duty resting on her own shoulders.
 
<te href=851074>Ashinohara</te> had long suffered under the <te href=850074>Threnodian's</te> shadow, forcing the land to weave its very survival around the mikos. As the bearer of the Suzu, Hiyuki's status was as uniquely sacred as it was heavy, and her jurisdiction covered the entirety of Ashinohara. She became a nomad of necessity, racing between different places to assist the local mikos and turn the tides of battle.
 
Yet a miko was as much a living symbol as a blade. Wherever people would gather, a miko must appear to remind them why they fought. The Miko of Flaming Sakura was no exception. Hiyuki carried both burdens well. Perhaps it was because she had learned each duty at Gyokuro's side since childhood, combat and ceremony alike had long since become second nature. The only thing missing was Gyokuro's specific Flaming Sakura swordsmanship. Gyokuro had stubbornly refused to pass down the forms, even going so far as to distance herself from Hiyuki.
 
"Fine. If you will not teach me, I will learn in secret. One day, I will master it. One day."
 
But that day never came.

"The Suzu allows the bearer to draw upon the future, and a successor who inherits the Suzu today might vanish into nothingness during their very first battle with a Threnodian..."
 
Hiyuki couldn't remember the words the steward whispered when placing the Suzu in her hands. She couldn't remember the clumsy way she tied it to her wrist, mimicking a gesture she had seen so many times. She couldn't recall the weather that day, or the face of the person who handed her the small wooden box containing Gyokuro's legacy.
 
By the time the world rushed back into focus, she was sitting alone in the hollowed halls of the seat of Flaming Sakura, clutching the wish slip that had been inside the box.
 
Blood froze in her chest. A creeping frost left her fingertips numb. Inch by inch, Hiyuki dragged herself to that familiar corner of the room and curled up. She had crumpled the wish slip earlier. Now she smoothed it flat. 
 
"...I see."
"...I accept your wish."
"...There will never be another Miko of Flaming Sakura."

stories.title: Snowed In
stories.content:
"Lady Hiyuki, you have served as the Miko of Flaming Sakura for a century now. If we are to renew the contract..."
"It is of no consequence."
"Then, as per our previous arrangement... for how many years shall we set the renewal?"
"Fill it as you wish."
"I did not expect you to be quite so like the previous Miko... Ahem. Very well. As you wish, Miko of Eternal Flaming Sakura."
 
The steward bowed and withdrew, closing the door with practiced reverence. Hiyuki noted that the staff accompanying him had changed three times over the decades. She shook her head, eyes narrowing as they fell upon the envelope on her desk. After a pause, she reached instead for a teacup that had long since gone cold.
 
"Just like the previous Miko... am I?"
 
How long had it actually been since she took up the title? 
Long enough that "Hiyuki" was now a fixed entry in <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te>'s history books. 
Was it a long time? 
Not long enough.
 
True to the fortune lot she had inherited that year, Hiyuki had used her own strength to prove a silent vow: There will never be another Miko of Flaming Sakura. Gradually, the voices urging her to select a successor had faded. The Office of Legacy Talismans now treated its visits to the shrine as a mere formality. Even the steward, she suspected, believed a successor unnecessary. To them, Hiyuki had become the title itself.
 
Yet Hiyuki often heard a voice. It wasn't the grating, persistent lure of the Fractsidus. It was a peaceful murmur stating facts plainly in her ear.
 
"Hiyuki, you have held on for so long. But your enemy, the <te href=850074>Threnodian</te>, has a far longer lifespan. It will wait until you die, until every miko, and every successor of every miko, has passed into memory."
"Does this path of resistance truly have an end?"
 
Cold tea is always the most bitter. The over-steeped acridity clung to her tongue, making each breath feel heavy. Hiyuki tapped a finger against the envelope on the desk. Instantly, a layer of frost raced across its surface. With one more light touch, the unopened Fractsidus seal shattered into crystalline dust.
 
Hiyuki rose and called out to the child who had volunteered to help clean the shrine, reminding her to stay vigilant and watch for intruders while she was away. Her lips curled into a smile as she ruffled the girl's hair and pressed a protective charm into her small palm.
 
"Lady Miko, where are you going to help this time?"
"Honami. I will be back soon. Keep this charm with you during this time, all right?"
 
Hiyuki waved goodbye to the little girl. As she turned to leave, the bell on her wrist caught the light, shining as brilliantly as ever.

stories.title: Vanished Honami
stories.content:
The people of <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te> had long grown accustomed to the distortions wrought by the <te href=850074>Threnodian</te>. Survival was a matter of routine: seek shelter, wait for the local miko to deploy, and if the situation spiraled, wait for the recovery teams and the Miko of Flaming Sakura to arrive.
 
To Hiyuki, this felt like just another fight among thousands. She cut through the monsters with practiced efficiency, checking the integrity of the barrier as she always did. As the civilians emerged from the shelters, parents pointed her out to their children with reverent relief. "Look, that's Lady Miko of Flaming Sakura."
 
Hiyuki offered a slight nod in response. She stepped over a fallen "No Entry" sign and turned back toward the barrier to finish her sweep.
 
Focus. Strike. Sheathe... Hm?
 
The blade passed through the air as it always did. Yet something was different. Subtle, but unmistakable.
 
Hiyuki reexamined the entire barrier. Everything appeared intact, yet a lingering, visceral wrongness clung to her fingertips. She released her hilt. Flexed her wrist. Pressed her fingers together—
 
A single drop of iridescent black mire welled from her skin. It pooled in the creases of her palm before dripping to the ground, spreading silently beneath her feet. 

Hiyuki drew her blade. Frost snapped into existence around her. First, contain it. Evacuate the civilians. Then find a way to—
 
She turned, but the cry died in her throat. There was nothing before her. It was as if the air itself vanished. For one frozen moment, Hiyuki could not breathe.
 
Honami was gone.

Aside from the shattered sign at her feet and a trace of mud creeping up the hem of her dress, there was nothing left.
 
Hiyuki reached out, but her hand recoiled on its own. She gasped for breath, but there was no oxygen. It was as if the atmosphere itself had been erased from existence. She raised her blade to strike, but found no enemy to sever. Only a faint, residual frequency remained, proof that the Threnodian had acted, for a fraction of a second, with power never before recorded.
 
According to Ashinohara's records, Honami had been pulled into another dimension at that moment. Even after a desperate appeal to the <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te> for their most advanced tracking technology, not a single trace could be found.
 
When the others finally led Hiyuki away, she was still mindlessly rubbing the bell on her wrist, her mind trapped in that moment of shock.

Was this silent disaster her fault?
Of course it was her fault. As the Miko of Flaming Sakura, she had failed to protect Honami.
And of course, it was not her fault. Against the power of a Threnodian, a single person didn't matter—even one who could draw a million futures to safeguard the present.
 
Hiyuki returned to the Flaming Sakura. She took the protective charm from the child at the gate, forcing a ghost of a smile. Then she walked slowly to her room and pushed open the door. There, sitting quietly on her desk, was the envelope she had destroyed.
 
"Hiyuki, oh Hiyuki... Does this path truly have an end?"

stories.title: Even Should the Path Have No End
stories.content:
Hiyuki didn't linger on the Fractsidus's many offers. No sane person would collaborate with those who viewed human lives as mere expendable fuel.
 
Instead, she traveled across <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te>, leaving behind white paper birds infused with her own frequency. She instructed the local mikos that her mind was linked to these messengers, and should any insurmountable incident occur, she would be there the moment they crushed the bird.
 
The path of resistance against the <te href=850074>Threnodians</te>... it had to have an end. It had to.
 
It was then that Hiyuki heard word that the <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te> was grappling with a critical lack of safety provisions for its expeditions. She saw an opportunity and proposed a "trade." She would ensure the safety of their exploration efforts, and in exchange, the Collective would forge her a blade using the pinnacle of Solaris technology. A weapon sharp enough to cleave through a Threnodian.
 
Hiyuki joined the Spacetrek Collective as part of the Special Response Force. The unit had once been large, but casualties mounted as Aleph-1 grew more active. So Hiyuki submitted a request, proposing that henceforth, she alone would handle Threnodian containment and ensure the safety of those conducting surveys.
 
When she first arrived here, the Collective was little more than a plot of foundation in the dirt. She watched as Lahai-Roi was built, step by step, and began to grasp the true measure of human potential. The facility's construction was a miracle, perhaps the greatest engineering feat in the history of <te href=850079>Solaris</te>. Yet it came not from gods, nor from any single hero. It was built, brick by brick, by people across all Solaris who dared to dream.
 
"Lucilla."
"Hmm?"

Lucilla casually pulled a bottle of fine liquor from beneath the desk, a specialty from Ashinohara. A student hoping to pass their finals had left it at one of Hiyuki's frequent haunts, tucked under a neat note asking for the miko's blessing.
 
Hiyuki sighed, set out two glasses, and pushed one toward the restless Lucilla.
 
"The Spacetrek Collective... it was built to explore the stars beyond Solaris, was it not?"
"That's the idea."
"How fares the progress?"
"Ugh..." Lucilla drained her drink in one go. "Still a long way off. Research is hitting walls everywhere, and the higher-ups keep breathing down our necks with impossible demands."
 
Hiyuki rubbed the bell on her wrist, her eyes downcast. 

"Have any of you ever wondered... where the end of this path is?"
 
Lucilla toyed with her empty glass, then gently clinked it against Hiyuki's.
 
"There is no end, Hiyuki. Just like what you're trying to do... No end."
"But we have to keep moving forward anyway."
"Not to reach a finish line, but to take one more step alongside the people standing next to us."
 
Hiyuki remained silent for a long time. Finally, she gave a soft nod and raised her glass, drinking deeply. The liquor scorched her throat and settled like lead in her slight frame.
 
The bell on her wrist chimed—a solitary sound, but the Miko of Flaming Sakura would take her next step regardless.

voices.title: Thoughts: I
voices.content: Aleph-1 has been driven back, for now. But its shadow lingers. There are still complications in <te href=260004>Lahai-Roi</te>, matters unfit for researchers that require my hand. Once they are settled, I intend to return to <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te> to see it for myself. Though it has already been... Well, perhaps we will meet again there.

voices.title: Thoughts: II
voices.content: About the Fractsidus... You remember how I can draw upon my futures with the Suzu's power? Among them was one where I became a <te href=850074>Threnodian</te> Resonator. That possibility proved I could bear its power, and marked me as a threat in the eyes of many. That is why the Fractsidus sought me out, time and again. But you need not worry. I burned that future to ash before your eyes. The line is drawn.

voices.title: Thoughts: III
voices.content: Tales of your exploits abound. Folk legends across countless regions, <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te> reports, slander from the lips of your enemies...Yet those remain merely the evaluations of others. It was not until I met you that I understood why they depict you as they do. Had our paths crossed sooner... I wonder, might mine have taken a different turn?

voices.title: Thoughts: IV
voices.content: There is something I wish... No, something I must confess to you. Even now, after our time together, a sour sentiment lingers within me. If I were to name it, I would call it "jealousy." I find myself imagining your power as my own, wondering if I, too, could have... Forgive me. I simply needed to exhale this poison. If my words trouble you... then I will bear whatever judgment you deem fitting.

voices.title: Thoughts: V
voices.content: I once wielded my blade to see it shatter. Each strike was my prayer for spring, for the snow to thaw, and... for my own release. I believed solitude was a fate I could not escape. But when I looked at you, I realized that perhaps I may yet cling to something in this fate. I am not you, and I will never become you. Our paths may have crossed but briefly, yet knowing you walk the same path as well... I no longer feel alone.

voices.title: Hiyuki's Hobby
voices.content: I sculpt figurines in my leisure time. It is an intricate process, demanding one's complete focus. A state I find grounding. And no matter the medium or style, there is always a reference, a clear set of steps to follow. Adhere to them, and a repeatable result is assured. Such certainty is rare to find these days.

voices.title: Hiyuki's Trouble
voices.content: <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te> still occupies my thoughts... but I would not call it a burden. The past is settled. What remains is to handle what was left behind. Even if it is nowhere to be found on any map, the land still carries a legacy meant to endure.

voices.title: Favorite Food
voices.content: Gyokuro tea. It is <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te>'s specialty. When I was young, I would steal sips from the adults' cups. All I tasted then was bitterness. But by the time I learned to appreciate the sweet aftertaste, I realized I had begun to miss that bitterness instead.

voices.title: Disliked Food
voices.content: Confections, I suppose... Not from any preference of palate. It is simply that sweetness, upon tasting, stirs memories of a bitter kind. The sweeter the past I once held, the more bitter the aftertaste that lingers.

voices.title: Ideals
voices.content: My wish is... that there will never be another Miko of Flaming Sakura. That no further fate need be bound to the <te href=850074>Threnodians</te>. Perhaps... all we have ever sought is a world where every soul is simply granted the right to live an ordinary life.

voices.title: Chat: I
voices.content: The bell I wear on my wrist is what we call a "Legacy Talisman" in <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te>. For us Mikos of Flaming Sakura, it is a sacred relic passed down through generations—a vessel of Ashinohara's wishes. Through it, I gain the power to burn my futures, a power said to originate from Ashinohara's Sentinel. I know you share a close bond with the Sentinels. If you wish to see it, I can show it to you. Oh... the cord tied to the bell? Gyokuro braided it for me when I was a child. That alone is mine. The only thing that is.

voices.title: Chat: II
voices.content: If you wish to know more about my past, you will find snippets of it in the records of <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te>. They tell a far more vivid tale than I ever could. After all, my only memory of the past is me striking that blade, again and again and again.

voices.title: About Lynae
voices.content: She is a bright spirit. I am aware of certain secrets she carries. In a sense, we are both bound by our pasts. But she has a future she is galloping toward, one filled with light and hope she wholly deserves. That said, I still believe she should refrain from using her Forte to slip into class when she is late.

voices.title: About Chisa
voices.content: Chisa is also from <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te>. I have made a point to avoid meeting her. After all, in our homeland, Mikos only appeared in the darkest of times. We were never omens of good fortune—perhaps a parallel can be drawn to those detective comics popular nowadays. Besides, it may be unsettling to see a name from history standing before you in the flesh. Also, please do not speak to her of what transpired in Ashinohara. That burden is not hers to bear.

voices.title: About Aemeath
voices.content: A resilient child. She surely endured unimaginable hardship to return here. When she vanished within the simulator cockpit, I was out on a field assignment. The investigation team later briefed me on her case. The detail that made me pause was her writing "saving the world" as her career aspiration... Hm, I find myself wondering... what in her upbringing instilled this level of conviction?

voices.title: About Sigrika
voices.content: She bears an awful load for a child of her age. She seeks to shoulder the expectations placed upon a <te href=700025>Solsworn</te> far ahead her own time. I have noticed her watching the Shiratori I send forth. Perhaps I should fold one for her before I depart?

voices.title: About Denia
voices.content: I... believe I failed her, in a way. Had I been quicker to see through the Fractsidus's plot, she might not have suffered as she did. I borrowed your strength when I delivered that strike. Only then was I able to restore a whisper of her true self back to her. I pray it caused no lasting harm. I am told that she is recovering. If we meet again, I will offer my apologies in person.

voices.title: About Lucilla
voices.content: Though Lucilla insists our partnership is only contractual, I am well aware that without her discreet arrangements, I would have no place in the <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te>, much less have obtained that blade. She carries herself lightly, yet the weight on her shoulders is plain to see. She often visits me, half in jest, declaring that she intends to "call it quits"—it is her way of venting. Before returning to <te href=851074>Ashinohara</te>, I should at least see her through the troubles presently at hand.

voices.title: Birthday Wishes
voices.content: A joyous birthday to you. The day of one's birth signifies the commencement of all things. It is a guidepost to your origin and an anchor should you ever drift. I first thought to prepare a traditional gift. Yet upon reflection, there is no offering more fitting than this single, blank paper. Please, write your wish here. Hold nothing back. Whatever it may be, I shall make it come true.

voices.title: Self-Introduction
voices.content: I am Hiyuki, the last Miko of Flaming Sakura. Should you seek to slay the Threnodians, my blade and I stand at your service.

voices.title: Ascension: I
voices.content: Hm, I feel it now. A sharper edge now rests within my grasp.

voices.title: Ascension: II
voices.content: To refine one's skill is a lifelong pursuit. Perhaps we may reach greater heights together.

voices.title: Ascension: III
voices.content: With this strength, I shall safeguard more wishes.

voices.title: Ascension: IV
voices.content: The path I walk stretches into the future. The wishes laid upon me… perhaps one day, I can finally make them...

voices.title: Ascension: V
voices.content: You hear the ring of my blade, do you not? It is the sound of my conviction to see through your wishes. Any of them.

voices.title: Heavy Attack: IV
voices.content: Is that the best you can do?

voices.title: Heavy Attack: VII
voices.content: Follow my moves, if you can.

voices.title: Heavy Attack: IX
voices.content: You've prepared for this, have you not?

voices.title: Resonance Liberation: II
voices.content: A life as fleeting as the first snow.

voices.title: Resonance Liberation: III
voices.content: Take your final dive, into Naraka.

voices.title: Resonance Liberation: IV
voices.content: May the sakura incinerate. Burn this self away.

voices.title: Resonance Liberation: V
voices.content: Roam above the inferno, gazing at the snow.

voices.title: Resonance Liberation: VI
voices.content: For all wishes spoken, this vessel I offer.

goods.title: Origami Familiar
goods.content:
Few would guess that the white birds soaring above the skies of <te href=260004>Lahai-Roi</te>, the very ones under the Miko of Flaming Sakura's command, could look so endearingly adorable up close.
 
Hiyuki's fingers are nimble, yet they seem to fail her whenever she attempts a "professional" origami bird. She even resorted to eavesdropping on origami lessons from outside a window, but the final result was always this same, harmlessly cute shape.

goods.title: Fortune Lot
goods.content:
A fortune lot from the Flaming Sakura. Its sakura motifs and divination text have been wholly obscured, buried beneath tiny white flowers gathered from somewhere unknown.

Hiyuki first drew this lot when she sought guidance, asking whether she would smoothly inherit the title of Miko of Flaming Sakura. Only days later, she discovered that someone had, in secret, stitched and reshaped her fortune into this form.

goods.title: Carving Kit Set
goods.content:
In her spare time, Hiyuki retreats to a secluded corner to carve. 
 
Figurines of people, animals, miniature landscapes, or scenes from art, she attempts to render them all with her carving knife. Recently, there is a rumor that her interest has shifted from the <te href=700022>Exoswarm</te> to the <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te>'s various mechanical constructs. Students have even reported glimpsing her in the frostlands, attempting to carve the likeness of the <te href=700008>Exostrider</te>.

Perhaps one day, the carving knife in her hand will finally replace the blade sheathed at her waist.

skill.name: Foreclaiming
skill.description:
<size=40><color=Title>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> becomes available after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self</color>.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=110806>Present Self</te></color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to cast this skill, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Upon casting this skill, gain 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color>, remove 300 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>. Then, enter <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color> and restore 50 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>.
<color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> applies 4 stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> on hit.
Casting <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> does not consume Resonance Energy.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color> can be cast via the following ways:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> and release to cast <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color>. If Hiyuki has 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>, consume all <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>. Otherwise, this cast does not consume <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>.
- Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to enter a charging state. During this state, consume 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color> periodically. Release <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color>. If no <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color> is consumed when <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> is released, Hiyuki will continue to charge the attack and cast the skill automatically after certain time. <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color> will also be cast automatically when <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color> depletes. 
Hiyuki deals <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Each point of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color> consumed increases the DMG Multiplier of this attack.
Casting the skill consumes 300 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>, and ends <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color>.
skill.simpleDescription:
<size=40><color=Title>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> becomes available after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self</color>.
Deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Upon casting, enter <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color></size>
Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to enter a charging state by continuously consuming <color=Highlight>Snowforged Blade</color>. Release <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. The more <color=Highlight>Snowforged Blade</color> consumed while charging the attack, the higher the DMG dealt.
After casting, exit <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>.

skill.name: Fine Snow
skill.description:
When a Resonator in the team applies <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> or <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color>, Hiyuki gains 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>. <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color> stacks up to {0} times. Each Resonator can trigger this effect only once in this way.
Based on Hiyuki's current stacks of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>, the following bonuses are unlocked:
1 stack of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te> DMG</color> is Amplified by {1} against targets within a certain range. Hiyuki's Crit. DMG is increased by {2}.
2 stacks of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, each time she applies <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color>, she additionally deals an instance of <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te> DMG</color> with a fixed DMG Multiplier of {3}.
3 stacks of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te> DMG</color> is additionally Amplified by {4} against targets within a certain range.
This effect resets when new Resonators are added to the team.

2 stacks of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>: While Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, each time she applies <color=Highlight>Glacio Chafe</color>, she additionally deals an instance of <color=Highlight>Glacio Bite DMG</color>.
3 stacks of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>: While Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, <color=Highlight>Glacio Bite DMG</color> taken by the targets is additionally Amplified.

In <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2</color>.

skill.name: Everfrost Dominion
skill.description:
<size=40><color=Title>Glacio Bite</color></size>
- While Hiyuki is in the team, <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> inflicted by nearby Resonators in the team is converted to <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color>. Every time a new stack of <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> is inflicted on a target, an instance of <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te> DMG</color> is triggered based on that enemy's current <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> stack limit. <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> can be inflicted on <color=Highlight>frozen</color> targets. <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> is also considered <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te> DMG</color> is also considered <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te> DMG</color>.
- When <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color> hits a target, if the target has no fewer than {0} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color>, consume <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} and trigger <color=Highlight><te href=110808>Frostbind</te></color> once. 
- When Hiyuki joins the team, remove all stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> from the targets. When Hiyuki leaves the team, if there is no other Resonator in the team who can convert <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> into <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color>, all enemies' <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> stacks are cleared.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Present Self</color></size>
Hiyuki starts in <color=Highlight><te href=110806>Present Self</te></color>. While in <color=Highlight><te href=110806>Present Self</te></color>, casting certain skills restores <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Foreclaimed Self</color></size>
Hiyuki enters <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color> after casting <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color>. While in <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color>, Hiyuki unlocks new moves and restores <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> through certain attacks.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Iai Stance</color></size>
If Hiyuki has at least 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>, performing any of the following actions causes her to flash backward at the cost of STA and enter <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> after casting any <color=Highlight>Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self</color> other than <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color>, <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Frostedge</color>.
- Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> within a certain period after casting <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color> or <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>.
While performing the actions above, if there is a valid target within the range and the forward input is held down, Hiyuki instead flashes behind the enemy at the cost of STA and enters <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>.
Hiyuki may enter <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color> while airborne. Upon entering the <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>, Hiyuki's mid-air Dodge charges are reset. <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color> ends if Hiyuki is switched out.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Iai</color></size>
Within a certain period after entering <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> and consume 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
If <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> remains at 100 points or above after casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color> again.
If Hiyuki is attacked by an enemy within a certain period during <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, neutralize this instance of damage and become immune to interruptions for a certain duration afterwards while reducing all incoming DMG by 100%.
Each time <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color> is cast, if Hiyuki has <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color>, consume 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color> to inflict 3 stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> on hit, and gain 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=110804>Whiteout Bitterfrost</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dedication</color></size>
Hiyuki holds up to  300 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.
While in <color=Highlight>Present Self</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> may be restored via the following ways:
- Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color> restores 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.
- Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Frostedge</color> restores 200 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Present Self</color> enhances the next <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color>, which now additionally restores 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>. This effect ends when Hiyuki is switched out.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Frostheart</color></size>
Hiyuki holds up to 300 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>.
<color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> is restored while casting <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color> and <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>, or when <color=Highlight>Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self</color> other than <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color> hits the target.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Frostharden Iai</color></size>
<color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color> has a maximum of 3 points.
Casting <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> grants 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Whiteout Bitterfrost</color></size>
<color=Highlight><te href=110804>Whiteout Bitterfrost</te></color> stacks up to 3 times.
Each time <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color> is consumed through <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, gain 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=110804>Whiteout Bitterfrost</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Snowforged Blade</color></size>
<color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color> stacks up to 3 times.
Each time <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color> is cast, gain 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>.
